name: mpyricalspace-build-status
description: Colours src/<model>/ folders in the Explorer by whether their compiled Fortran extension loads (python -m mpyricalspace doctor).

mpyricalspace.pythonPath.description: Interpreter used for 'python -m mpyricalspace doctor'. Empty = the Python extension's selected interpreter, falling back to 'python3'.

mpyricalspace.decorateBadges.description: Show a check / cross badge on the folder (the colour is applied regardless).
